summary: A small task from a blank file that mixes the week: a fake LLM client from Day 5, request and response models from Day 9 and 11, and one test through TestClient. You also meet a blank-text request that gives a 500 and turn it into a clear 400.
goal: Build POST /api/summarize from a blank file, with a fake LLM and tests that prove it.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then read the contract
Step 1: write FakeLlmClient in llm.py and run mypy to see Success: no issues found
Step 2: write the models and POST /api/summarize, then match the 200 response with max_words 5
Step 3: write one TestClient test and see 1 passed, then break it by changing words to 6
Step 4: send blank text, see the 500, turn it into a 400 and add a second test
Play the Test Detective game to the end and see your score
